datasets.name: Poland - Geoportal standard orthophoto
datasets.attribution: Glowny Urzad Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK), Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.license: Use according to the terms published by Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.information: Current standard-resolution Polish orthophoto mosaic. At 4096, TSRE composes four parallel 2048-pixel exports for faster loading; the lower quality choices use one request. Cached images expire after 30 days because the service is updated over time.

datasets.name: World - ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 RGB 2021
datasets.attribution: ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by the ESA WorldCover consortium
datasets.information: Global display-ready true-colour Sentinel-2 mosaic. Acquisition is capped near the product's useful 10 m resolution.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS imagery (fast cached ~2 m)
datasets.attribution: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official cached USGS imagery basemap, predominantly USDA NAIP over the contiguous United States. Source imagery is primarily 0.6 m, but the published cache ends at zoom 16 and supplies roughly 1.5-2.2 m ground pixels across this coverage. Cached tiles expire after 30 days because the mosaic is updated over time.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS NAIP Plus (0.5-2 m)
datasets.attribution: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official dynamic USGS NAIP Plus ImageServer. Choose 4000 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4000 mode composes four parallel 2000-pixel exports. Source imagery varies from about 0.15 m to 1 m and is served in natural colour. High-resolution requests take longer than the separate cached USGS source.

datasets.name: Czechia - CUZK Ortofoto CR (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (CUZK)
datasets.information: Official Ortofoto CR Web Mercator export service. The source product has 12.5 cm pixels and a two-year national update cycle. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode composes four parallel 2048-pixel exports, replacing hundreds of individual WMTS tile requests.

datasets.name: Slovakia - GKU Ortofotomozaika SR (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Geodetic and Cartographic Institute Bratislava (GKU), National Forest Centre (NLC)
datasets.information: Official current Slovak national orthophotomosaic. The third production cycle contains 15 cm imagery acquired in 2023 in western, 2024 in central, and 2025 in eastern Slovakia. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode composes four parallel 2048-pixel exports.

datasets.name: Netherlands - PDOK current RGB aerial imagery (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.information: Official current nationwide 25 cm RGB aerial-photo mosaic. The Actueel layer follows the most recent complete national year. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel WMS blocks because PDOK limits each image to 2500 pixels per side.

datasets.name: France - IGN BD ORTHO 20 cm (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Institut national de l'information geographique et forestiere (IGN)
datasets.information: Official current 20 cm BD ORTHO aerial imagery for metropolitan France, requested in its native Lambert-93 projection. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The default is 2048 because the 4096 export is substantially slower. Parallel blocks are disabled because this service queues concurrent large requests.

datasets.name: Belgium - Flanders latest winter orthophoto (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.license: Digitaal Vlaanderen geographic web-services terms; public access without restrictions
datasets.information: Official 15 cm compilation of the most recent winter orthophotos available for each part of Flanders and Brussels. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests.

datasets.name: Belgium - Wallonia orthophotos spring 2025 (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Orthophotos 2025 - Printemps
datasets.information: Official complete 25 cm spring 2025 orthophoto coverage of Wallonia. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. One WMS request is used because it outperformed concurrent blocks on this service. This dated edition is cached without expiry.

datasets.name: Spain - IGN PNOA latest orthophotos (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Sistema Cartografico Nacional de Espana (scne.es), IGN/CNIG
datasets.information: Official latest PNOA orthophoto mosaic, normally 25 or 50 cm depending on the area, including mainland Spain and islands. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests.

datasets.name: Lithuania - Geoportal ORT10LT latest imagery (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: National Land Service of Lithuania, geoportal.lt
datasets.license: Use according to geoportal.lt public-service terms; source attribution required
datasets.information: Official current ORT10LT national aerial imagery, presently combining 2022-2025 acquisitions and limited satellite imagery. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel ArcGIS exports.

datasets.name: Estonia - Maa- ja Ruumiamet latest orthophoto (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Orthophoto, Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
datasets.license: Open public data; source attribution required
datasets.information: Official latest national orthophoto mosaic in the native L-EST97 grid. Approximately half of Estonia is renewed each year and larger settlements may be updated annually. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests.

datasets.name: Croatia - DGU orthophoto 2023/2024 (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: State Geodetic Administration of the Republic of Croatia (DGU)
datasets.license: DGU public WMS terms; source attribution required
datasets.information: Official complete national DOF5 orthophoto cycle: eastern and southern Croatia acquired in 2023 and western Croatia in 2024. It is used instead of the newer 2025/2026 service while that cycle covers only part of the country. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests.

datasets.name: Slovenia - GURS current orthophoto (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS)
datasets.license: Slovenian open-data terms; source attribution required
datasets.information: Official current national orthophoto overview, serving detailed DOF025 imagery at large scales in the native D96/TM grid. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests.

datasets.name: Luxembourg - orthophoto summer 2025 (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
datasets.license: Geoportail Luxembourg public-service terms; source attribution required
datasets.information: Official country-wide summer 2025 orthophoto with ground resolution at or below 10 cm. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel 2048-pixel WMS requests and is cached as a dated edition.
